mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320) indicates central bank policy failure and imminent rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 320, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
